changelog: Added android automation support(MCP) in settings/utilities to let model control the phone
Added adb connect and pairing support in settings/utilities
WebView Extensions are now called Custom AntiGem Plugins
Plugins can include skills (guides that teach the model how to use the plugin's tools); a plugin can also be skills only
New /plu: slash command in chat to point the model at a plugin or one of its skills
New Settings → Slash Commands: create your own / commands, plus a built-in /custom_plugin that helps you create a plugin
Plugin repositories: add a GitHub repository to browse, install and update its plugins; includes a guide to host your own
Plugins now show their icon and version, and updates show the installed and new version
Installing a plugin that is already installed asks whether to update it or install it as a separate copy
Remove a plugin, or download it as a ZIP to share
Download the Plugin SDK as a ZIP to build plugins on your PC
